title: fix(runtime, rest): the /meta door's 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT carries details.candidates, as /automation and /actions do (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLcR66HDKGmkegYSEN3PSwY)_

Fixes #32201

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按名读取元数据时（`GET /meta/:type/:name`、`?package=`、`/meta/:type/:ns/:name`、`/meta/:type/_env/:name`），只要地址指不到唯一一项而返回 `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，应答现在在 `details.candidates` 里列出每个持有者（`{ kind: 'package', packageId }` 等），格式与 `/automation`、`/actions` 一致。消息文字不变。两个传输都改了：云端走的 runtime 调度器，和 `objectstack serve` / `os dev` 走的 RestServer。
- 为什么改：两个已安装的包用同一个名字发布元数据时，Console 或集成通过 SDK（`client.meta.getItem`）读取必须选定持有者。以前持有者只写在消息里，调用方只能解析英文句子；现在可以直接拿列表带上 `namespace` 或 `packageId` 重试。
- 风险与回滚：纯增量，只在已经是 409 的应答上多一个 `details` 成员，成功的应答一字不变。列出的持有者就是消息里已经点名的那些，不多泄露任何信息；类型级读权限不够的调用方仍在读地址之前得到 403，看不到持有者。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 的 `packageScopedRefusalAnswer` 和它的两个调用点；`packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` 的 `RouteErrorOptions` 与 `packageScopedCandidatesMember`，以及两个 `/meta` 读路由传入的 `{ packageScopedCandidates: true }`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` 和 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`，预期各有 5 例 `#32201` 新增用例全过；去掉候选列表的携带后这 10 例全部变红（下文有记录）。
- 需要你做的：无。席位做契约复审，史诗席位做红线复审后由席位落地。

## What changes

**The gap (measured on main `6440802a`).** Every `/meta` read form already answered the package-scoped refusal (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`) as `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the holders named in the message. The thrown error carries them structurally (`refusal.candidates`), but neither transport put them on the wire:

- runtime dispatcher: `errorFromThrown` → `thrownAnswerOf` builds `details` from `issues` / `fields` only, so the nested body had no `details`;
- `RestServer`: `handleRouteError` → the flat classification door's 4xx passthrough wrote `{ error, code }` only.

**Which code path each read form takes.**

| Read form | runtime dispatcher (`domains/meta.ts`) | `RestServer` |
|---|---|---|
| bare `GET /meta/:type/:name` | `protocol.getMetaItem` throws → the item read's outer `catch` | the item read handler's `catch` (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`) |
| `?package=` | same as bare | same as bare |
| `/meta/:type/:ns/:name`, a namespace holding none of the name | `resolveMetaItemAddress` → rewritten to `?package=<holder>` → outer `catch` | `meta-qualified-item-route.ts` rewrites to `?package=` → the item read handler's `catch` |
| `/meta/:type/:ns/:name`, a shareable namespace both owners hold (ADR-0150 D2) | `resolveMetaItemAddress` throws → the address read's `catch` (the order's "~L1089" site) | `resolveMetaItemAddress` throws → the qualified route's `catch` |
| `/meta/:type/_env/:name` | `admitEnvironmentQualifier` throws → outer `catch` | `admitEnvironmentQualifier` throws → the qualified route's `catch` |

Both transports serve all four forms. The order's "~L1936 / ~L2135" comments are the `_env` admission and the `getMetaItem` rethrow; both land in the outer `catch`.

**The fix.**

- **runtime, `domains/meta.ts`:** `packageScopedRefusalAnswer(deps, e)` answers `deps.error(e.message, 409, { code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', candidates })`, the shape `automation.ts` and `catalog-activation.ts` already answer. Both catch sites call it for a value `isPackageScopedRefusal` admits. The candidates are read off the thrown refusal; nothing is rebuilt from holders. A refusal with no candidate list answers what it did (`errorFromThrown`).
- **rest, `error-response.ts`:** `handleRouteError` takes an optional `RouteErrorOptions`. With `packageScopedCandidates: true`, the 4xx passthrough adds `details: { candidates }` to the flat body it already builds, for a package-scoped refusal only. `error` and `code` stay as they were. Only the two `/meta` read catches pass it; every other route's answer is unchanged.
- **`thrownAnswerOf` (`@objectstack/types`) is not changed** (order assumption 3). The client's fetch layer lifts `err.details = body.details ?? body.error.details ?? body`, so the nested `error.details.candidates` and the flat `details.candidates` both reach `err.details.candidates`. Pinned through the real dispatcher in `packages/client/src/package-addressing.test.ts` §4c.
- **client doc (card item 3):** #32197 has merged, so `client.meta.getItem`'s doc now says the rejection lists the holders on `err.details.candidates`, `addressCandidatesOf`'s doc names `/meta` beside `/actions` and `/automation`, and the unreleased `.changeset/31695-client-namespace-address.md` drops "The `/meta` door names the holders in its message only, so a `meta.getItem` rejection carries no `details.candidates`."

**Security boundary.** No new reader: the candidates are the holders the message already named. A caller the type-level read admission refuses is still answered `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` before the address is read, on both transports (the existing "never the 409 naming the holders" pins are unchanged and green).

**Semver.** `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author can write changes. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: an additive member on an existing refusal. A non-protocol widening ships `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3): `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/client` (doc text in the published declarations).

## Approved deviations (seat ruling, server seat 2)

1. **`packages/rest/**`.** The order's surface named the runtime door only. `objectstack serve` / `os dev` compose `createRestApiPlugin`, whose `RestServer` serves the `/meta` item read and the qualified read, so without it the standalone server kept answering no candidates. The seat widened the surface to the two rest `/meta` catches plus one shared helper. The helper is the `RouteErrorOptions` opt-in on `handleRouteError`, not a separate response module: a module writing its own body was refused by `check:route-envelope` as a new unenveloped body ("Raising the declared number is not the fix"), so the candidates ride the flat door's existing body instead.
2. **Item 3, client doc and changeset text** (`packages/client/src/index.ts`, `package-address.ts`, `.changeset/31695-client-namespace-address.md`), because #32197 merged.
3. **Client test assertions:** two `err.details?.candidates` lines in `package-addressing.test.ts` §4c, measuring what the SDK reads through the real dispatcher (order assumption 3).

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note

`check-empty-changeset` is red by design here: this PR rewrites `.changeset/31695-client-namespace-address.md`, which #32197 added and which no release has consumed yet. This change makes one of its sentences false, so restoring it from the base would publish that false sentence. Confirmed by the dispatching seat's record, per the gate's own text.

- Note: `.changeset/31695-client-namespace-address.md` (`@objectstack/client`, from #32197).
- Before: "The `automation.*` and `meta.getItem` calls reject with it, and on `/automation` the error's `details.candidates` lists every holder (`{ kind: 'package', packageId }`). `actions.invoke` and `invokeGlobal`, which return their failures instead of throwing, now carry those candidates on the result as `candidates`. The `/meta` door names the holders in its message only, so a `meta.getItem` rejection carries no `details.candidates`."
- After: "The `automation.*` and `meta.getItem` calls reject with it, and the error's `details.candidates` lists every holder (`{ kind: 'package', packageId }`). `actions.invoke` and `invokeGlobal`, which return their failures instead of throwing, now carry those candidates on the result as `candidates`."

## Tests

One pin per read form on each transport, each asserting `status` 409, the code, and `details.candidates` deep-equal to the holders, plus the shareable-namespace refusal:

- runtime: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, `describe('#32201 — …')`, 5 tests (nested body, `error.details.candidates`);
- rest: `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, `describe('#32201 — …')`, 5 tests (flat body, `details.candidates`; also asserts `error` is still the string sentence).

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation and restore proven on disk; each run separately):

- runtime carry: `candidates: candidates as readonly PackageScopedHolder[]` → `candidates: undefined`. The 5 runtime `#32201` tests fail, each `expected [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', undefined ]` against the holder list. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- rest carry: `...packageScopedCandidatesMember(error, options),` → `...({}),`. The 5 rest `#32201` tests fail, e.g. `{"error":"The dashboard \"sales\" is held by 2 packages …","code":"RESOURCE_CONFLICT"}: expected [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', undefined ]`. Restored, blob == HEAD.

## Gates (local, on `1d52e748`; then `origin/main` merged at `5b235a07`, no overlap but the client JSDoc, client test + `tsc` re-run green)

- Suites: `@objectstack/rest` 405/405 files (7975 passed, 355 skipped); `@objectstack/runtime` 580/580 files (10975 passed, 19 skipped); `@objectstack/client` 57/57 files (800 passed).
- Typecheck: `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 and `check:test-typecheck` exit 0 for rest, runtime and client.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 9 touched `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 72 derived; each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran`: exit 0, "72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED".
  - 68 exit 0, including `check:route-envelope`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: exit 3 on the shallow clone (fixture commit unreachable); after `git fetch origin 621a4876…` exit 0, 48 cases pass.
  - `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`: exit 1, by design: the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above.
  - NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite: a full build): `spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. CI runs both.

## Follow-up (noted, not filed)

Other by-name doors that answer the same `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` through the shared doors (`errorFromThrown` on the dispatcher, `handleRouteError` on `RestServer`), for example the sharing-rule declared-name doors (`sharing-rule-declared-name-conflict.test.ts`), still name the holders in the message only. Converging every such door at once belongs in the shared doors (`thrownAnswerOf` and the flat passthrough), not in this card.
